name: Thick Pelt always reduces physical damage taken by 15 plus 20% of melee AP and ignores the Bloodmage's own swings (#2325, #4709, #12568)
contract: Thick Pelt 704626 arms Thick Pelt 556233 on physical damage taken; its talent text gives the reduction as Thick Pelt 556233's 15 base plus 20% of melee AP. #12568: the server applied 15 - 20% of AP clamped at zero, so below 75 AP the talent did nothing, and the client text added the base's -15 sign, showing a negative reduction. The amount is now -(15 + 20% of the applying Bloodmage's BASE_ATTACK power), a reduction at every level; the client rows carry both texts with ${15+$AP*0.2}. Spell.dbc gives 704626 ProcFlags 0x4 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK), so the spell_proc override sets it to 680 (taken physical melee/ranged events). Each Bloodmage takes a real incoming hit from a hostile player actor (the harness fixture creature is passive and cannot attack back); the 1000-damage white hit is the server's incoming melee calculation with and without the armed helper. The amount is snapshotted when 556233 applies.
